spans.title: A Question in the Park
spans.blurb: In a holiday crowd, a shy suitor keeps losing his nerve until a chance meeting with a frail girl in a mystery wheelchair speaks for him.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that Millard's courtship of Phillida ends in an engagement, a development the novel stages.

spans.title: The Master Mathematician
spans.blurb: His calculations finished after four sleepless nights, a mathematician looks from his window at a strange new star and decides what to tell his students at noon.

spans.title: The First of All Axes
spans.blurb: Dawn creeps over a chalk cliff where two sleepers camp on a narrow ledge. Something huge is climbing down the gully toward them, and the fire is ash.

books.pairNote: Drawn from two different tales in the collection, with no shared text and separate payoffs.

spans.title: The Bell in the Chimney
spans.blurb: In a pitch dark cell, a young prisoner wakes to a small bell ringing from nowhere, then taps beneath the floor, then a string swinging at his window.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the hero Gaston is eventually imprisoned in the Bastille, a later turn in the novel.

spans.title: The Masked Princess
spans.blurb: In a hidden palace, a masked lady tells a young chevalier she is a persecuted princess seeking a champion. He pledges his sword half in jest.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the staged unmasking of the conspiracy's patron as the Duchesse de Maine.

spans.title: The Captain's Lesson
spans.blurb: Six gentlemen walk into a quiet glade to settle affairs of honor, and an old campaigner turns his duel with a furious boy into a fencing lesson.

books.pairNote: The duel and the recruitment are separate early scenes with no shared text, and each keeps its own payoff.

spans.title: Farewell at Fraunces Tavern
spans.blurb: A victorious general embraces his weeping officers at a tavern by the ferry, settles his accounts to the penny, and asks leave to become a private citizen.

spans.title: The Silent Target
spans.blurb: Outside a frontier dance, a lone watcher quietly turns troublemakers away so the music never stops, and pays a price nobody inside ever notices.

spans.title: The Wrestling Crown
spans.blurb: Twenty thousand hold their breath as an Athenian and a furious Spartan meet for the final wrestling of the games, two casts out of three for the crown.

spans.title: A City Begs Its King
spans.blurb: A king steps out to find his whole city kneeling at his altars, wreathed and wailing, while a priest gives voice to a land wasted by plague.

spans.title: A Night in the Castle
spans.blurb: Two travelers land at dawn in Finland, set on sleeping in a ruined island castle, whatever the bats, the owls, and the Mayor may say.

spans.title: Terms of Surrender
spans.blurb: A knight delivers his commander's terms to a besieged lady, who tears them to pieces and dashes them in his face. What he admits next softens her.
spans.brokenNote: The text stops partway through the lady's closing sentence, cutting off the scene's final beat.
